entities.summary: Angelo Sierre Blackson is an American professional football defensive end. He played college football for the Auburn Tigers and was drafted by the Tennessee Titans in the fourth round of the 2015 NFL draft. He has also played in the NFL for the Houston Texans, Arizona Cardinals, Chicago Bears, and Jacksonville Jaguars.
